messages:
anya (PM): Quick triage: MedicareApp asked for a small-scope pilot of an \"Optimize Advisor\" that gives per-route batching/caching presets, a ranked list of quantization profiles, and eval-triggered regression alerts. They want concierge onboarding + ability to flip to self-serve after pilot. They want results in ~6 weeks. Can we propose a compact scope?
matt (Eng): I can do a compact MVP if we cut features: no in-cluster auto-quantize, limit models to Redwood-verified open LMs, and alerting only to Console + weekly digest email. Need to confirm eval infra capacity.
ravi (ML): For alerts we need a baseline and a repeatable eval pipeline. Recommend customers provide 300 representative examples (input + expected output or metric oracle). We can seed regressions to validate alert precision.
leah (Solutions): MedicareApp will provide sanitized prompts. They want conservative alerting (low false positives) and a human review gate before customer notifications during concierge. They also asked for an ROI card estimating monthly token savings.
sophie (CS): Add: include p99 latency delta guidance when we suggest quant profiles. They worry about client-side SLOs. Also ask for a simple toggle to disable telemetry sharing.
anya (PM): Proposed MVP checklist: MUST: 1) automated batch/cache recommendations surfaced in Console 2) quant recommendation doc (ranked shortlist + tradeoffs) 3) eval-runner + alerting wired to Console and email 4) onboarding runbook for concierge SHOULD: 1) cost savings estimate 2) seed-regression harness for verification COULD: per-route simulation and dedicated capacity behavior.
matt (Eng): Implementation notes: offline analyzer that takes a traffic snapshot + perf traces to suggest batch_size, prefix_cache_policy, and recommended quant candidates. Eval runner = k8s CronJob that runs provided evaluation vectors against pinned model/version. Alert router uses existing Console alerts API.
ravi (ML): Alert logic suggestion: detect significant drop in primary metric OR sustained increase in token-level perplexity. Example rule: \"trigger if metric_delta <= -4% over baseline and sustained for 3 runs\". Seeded-regression plan: random prompt truncation, increased temperature, and prompt template corruption. Measure precision & recall.
leah (Solutions): Onboarding: we'll do concierge for first 4 customers: 1) data intake + obfuscation guide 2) run analyzer on 2 days of traffic 3) present recommendations + ROI card 4) agree thresholds and human-review flow. MedicareApp ok with hosted MVP.
anya (PM): Risk register: - noisy alerts -> spam and churn - quant recommendations degrade long-context use cases - privacy concerns about eval data - not enough representative traffic for recommendations
oliver (PM): Mitigations: default conservative thresholds, optional human triage step before alerts, require customer opt-in for telemetry, explicit caveat for long-context routes in the quant doc.
matt (Eng): Rough resource estimate: 2w core implementation (analyzer + eval runner) + 1w integration w/ Console alerts + 1w polish + 1w pilot = 5w if we allocate 1 eng + 1 infra + 0.5 PM + 0.5 ML eng. Dependencies: Console alert API, job runner quotas, model perf profiler.
leah (Solutions): Success metrics for pilot acceptance: - Customer accepts recommendations for >=1 critical route OR token-cost estimate >=8% savings on simulated workload - Alert precision >=65% on seeded events - Concierge onboarding completed within 3 weeks
sophie (CS): Recommend adding an \"alert throttling\" knob to avoid multiple noisy notifications during a short window. Also provide a weekly digest by default with optional immediate critical alerts.
anya (PM): Example alert config sample (for spec):
```
alert_config:
  target_metric: "intent_accuracy"
  baseline_days: "14"
  trigger_condition: "delta_pct <= -0.04 AND consecutive_runs >= 3"
  severity_mapping: "critical:immediate,warning:weekly_digest"
  human_review: true
```
matt (Eng): I'll draft the tech spec and the analyzer proto this week. Ravi will own seeded-regression harness. Leah will confirm dataset timeline with customer. Oliver will draft SLA language for pilot.
ravi (ML): I'll prepare a small synthetic toolkit to run seeded regressions and measurement scripts.
leah (Solutions): I'll schedule the concierge kickoff with MedicareApp and confirm they can deliver 300 sanitized vectors by next Tue.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy optimize-advisor/compact-mvp -> staging at 2024-11-18T16:00:00Z
anya (PM): Quick react check: :thumbsup: if you accept the compact MVP scope as described, :thumbsdown: for objections. I'll convert to an epic and circle back with timelines.
